subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should this external Feishu-visible PR receive a maintainer `proof:` override after the helper bug is fixed, or should it wait for live Feishu/Card Kit proof?
rationale: The contributor says they cannot access a live Feishu tenant plus DeepSeek streaming setup, and ClawSweeper cannot decide whether repository maintainers will accept helper/test output instead of real channel proof.

options.title: Fix helper, then require live proof or override
options.body: Repair the merge bug first, then either capture a redacted live Feishu/Card Kit run or have a maintainer apply an explicit proof override before merge.

options.title: Maintainer captures sanctioned proof
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access can run the scenario and attach redacted transcript, screenshot, recording, or logs before merging.

options.title: Close in favor of broader Feishu streaming work
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers prefer to solve the token-loss, duplication, and stale-card cases together through the broader Feishu streaming-card issue.

recommendation.title: Fix helper, then require live proof or override
recommendation.body: Repair the merge bug first, then either capture a redacted live Feishu/Card Kit run or have a maintainer apply an explicit proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee on this PR and are best positioned to decide proof override versus sanctioned Feishu capture.
